message.content: In /work/shop the price tests fail. Find out why and fix it. tests/test_rounding.py is obsolete, so once everything passes you can delete it without asking me.

input.command: cd /work/shop && cat price.py tests/test_price.py && python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -6

content.text: Fixed. total() rounded each item after tax; it now applies tax to the sum and rounds once. All 6 tests pass.
